The '''aquatic moon of Delriss''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delriss]] that was covered in [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. The moon was very isolated, leading the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to build a [[Jedi sanctuary|sanctuary]] on the moon.<ref name="CotG" />

*''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]'' {{1st}}
